english.title: Speeding - use low platform trailer exceeding 40 miles per hour

additionalkeywords.additionalkeyword: ROAD VEHICLES CONSTRUCTION AND USE REGULATIONS 1986

english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) used on a road, namely **(..SPECIFY ROAD AND LOCATION..), a vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..),

(A)_[displaying]_
(B)_[displaying a thing resembling]_

the rectangular plate described in the definition of 'low platform trailer' in the table in regulation 3(2) of the Road Vehicles (Construction and Use) Regulations 1986 at a speed exceeding 40 miles per hour
english.legislation: Contrary to regulation 100A(1) of the Road Vehicles (Construction and Use) Regulations 1986, section 42 of the Road Traffic Act 1988 and Schedule 2 to the Road Traffic Offenders Act 1988.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
use on a road a vehicle
speed exceeding 40 mph
when displaying a low platform trailer plate/similar

investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure

english.notes:
(i) Statement of Facts procedure applies - see end of document for wording
(ii) See offence wordings H3215 and H3216 for related offences.
(iii) A notice of intended prosecution IS required for this offence
